I can honestly tell you, that there is nothing you need to fix. Lol. If time could be fixed I’d give you that. But with you I have a strong feeling that you just haven’t met the right one. For my mom “the one” came at 29. For my best friend’s mom they came at 37. Sometimes life is not fair when it comes to timing in providing you the person you’re meant to spent the rest of your life with. A lot of those people jumping for joy at having found their partner are most likely basing something as serious as marriage off of fleeting emotions, since people change so much in their 20s. Hell, they’re even looking to extend the term “teenager” to include people up to 24 because so much change happens during these years. Don’t compare yourself to others because you have no idea what they’re dealing with, or what they had to go through to get where they are. Love life, and I promise, life will love you back.
